stage: Bounded exploratory numerical evaluation, not held-out confirmation or a test of divine origin.
source: All 1689 simple physical DSS islands >=9 letters used in CTRL-005 and TRANSFER-002, with the same 706 verse groups and original order. No filtering to multi-scroll agreement, unchanged modern anchors, favorable chronology or output preservation. K Greek letters always require K+1 contiguous source letters.
destination: All 7939 SBLGNT verse units and their original word boundaries in the already verified common Greek policy, 679879 letters. Use the exact Greek side of EXP-005. No concatenation of verses, preferred books, removed quotations, or exclusion of ordinary repeated language.
family_search: Exactly the calibrated FAM-004 engine: all 768 formulas, K=8..32, both Hebrew directions, a single formula/sense for three distinct groups on each side, no diversity exclusion, full per-rule scores and all positive maximizing IDs with deterministic witnesses. Unchanged native source hashes must match CAL-010.
references: Both within-unit labelled word permutation and global length-preserving vocabulary bijection. Reselect the entire family/length/position/triple maximum in each reference. Inclusive p=(1+exceedances)/1000. Retain all maxima and exact first/last reference inputs for each model; no new seed or reference count after seeing results.
numerical_alert: Score>=16 and p<=0.01 under BOTH models, regardless of how many formula parameters tie. Report all ties and separately whether exactly one parameter/sense combination maximizes. Family uniqueness does not establish uniqueness among all short programs or all witness triples.
multiple_selection: This is the sixth exposed target evaluation and the fourth family explored on the target, with partial overlap with FAM-001. Full-family reselection calibrates only this finite scan within each reference model. The 0.01 threshold is exploratory triage, not a study-wide significance claim, and indefinite repeated exploration at this threshold would eventually produce false alerts. All past and future attempts remain counted. Any later confirmation requires a separate prespecified cumulative error budget and genuinely reserved data; none is available here.
variant_transfer: Use frozen TRANSFER-002 policy for any alert: source coordinates require unique forced contiguous anchoring of K+1 letters; evaluate the SAME a,b,c,direction and the actual fixed Greek output in every eligible same-verse Hebrew island. Preserve all projection paths, changes, compensation and missing coverage; the source island is an identity check, not independent corroboration. Partial adjacent-pair coverage must also be checked before claiming robustness. Evaluate Greek support separately in BOTH already imported Sinaiticus transcriptions; agreement is not independence of manuscripts. No post-hoc displacement, alternate normalization, witness exclusion, gap bridging, or formula refit.
positive_followup: If a numerical alert occurs, freeze all maximizing rule parameters and complete input/output hashes immediately, before further empirical tests. Suspend expansion to new families and exhaustively enumerate every length-K literal occurrence for those fixed rules under the declared resource bounds, rather than selecting only the deterministic reported triple. Build variant and Greek support dossiers for all of them, retain disagreement and uncertainty, and test human quotation/translation/reuse explanations. The current numerical report alone retains no scientifically confirmed candidate; positive follow-up and external held-out confirmation are mandatory outstanding work. A failed chosen triple is not proof that every triple of its rule fails.
negative_interpretation: If score zero, no admissible three-passage relation exists in this bounded exact grammar on this exposed input. A shorter or nonsignificant positive score is reported as such. Neither outcome excludes other programs or divine origin; the ultimate goal remains open.
verification: Reconstruct the Hebrew selection and common-policy Greek stream independently, retaining all source coordinates and raw word boundaries. Independently recalculate every observed rule score, maximizing ID, literal witness, seed pair count, address counts, reference p-values and alert flags. Check both reference-model invariants and first/last reference maxima by the literal-program oracle; all intervening maxima remain archived but not individually recomputed by that oracle.
resource_failure: The FAM-004 guards remain unchanged. A failure yields an incomplete archived attempt, never a truncated negative result or permission to adapt the family within this evaluation.
registration: Local protocol freeze before the new target run; all source material was already exposed and no external preregistration, sealed reserve, independent scientific replication or publication exists.
